# Notes and citations

A regular note[^ordinary] precedes a note citation @doe2020.

A second note citation @knuth1984[p. 12].

The ordinary note is repeated[^ordinary].

A parent note contains another citation[^parent].

A grouped note citation [@doe2020; @lee2019].

Prose in a note style [@doe2020]{.prose} retains the engine's output.

Hidden [@lee2019]{.none} adds no note.

[^ordinary]: An ordinary footnote with *emphasis*.
[^parent]: Parent note text with a nested note citation @lee2019.
